notes.title: 1.19.10 beta
notes.content:
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Setting fps to 0 now uncap the framerate.
[*] Project and collection metadata now support custom tags.
[*] [noparse][Preview] Selection now won't start until the mouse has move a small amount.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Inspector] Add button to upload already uploaded project as a new workshop submission.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Inspector] Add button to use current Steam username as Author metadata.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Inspector] Add project rename button.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Inspector] Add option to update project thumbnail.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Graph] Hovering on output junction now temporary set graph preview surface.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Workshop] Project update notes can now be set.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Workshop] Workshop thumbnail frame now use current accent color.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Splash] Add right click menu for recent files for opening project in safe mode, open in file explorer.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][File Selector] Add thumbnail support for collection (or project with external thumbnail file.)[/noparse]
[/list]

[h2]Node[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Fluffify node
[*] New Maze Pattern node
[*] New MK Panels node
[*] New Blend Depth node
[*] Toggling value mapping now won't reset current value.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [noparse][Canvas] Copy/Paste selection hotkey can now be modified in preference.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Canvas] Add hotkey for adding frame (Alt+N).[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Canvas] Selection selection now pixel-based instead of bounding box-based.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Canvas] Selection can now be scale and rotate.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Canvas] Add multiple outputs output type.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Aseprite] Importing layer with a single frame will disable animation.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Liquefy] Add add node alias.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Shape] Add more gizmos to control shape properties.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Shape] Add twist, shear deformation.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Shape > Gear] Add Teeth Taper.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Cellular Noise] Add inverse, iteration properties.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Solid] Mask now use brightness and opacity.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][2D Extrude] Add mask input.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Repeat] Add global anchoring property.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Repeat] Add independent scale axis.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][FXAA] Add channel selector, mask.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Armature Bind] Inverse layer order to match composite node.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Draw Ribbon] Add fake thickness property.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Number] Add seed display type.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Draw Line] Add square cap.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Bevel] Improve output quality.[/noparse]
[/list]

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix software hangs on loading scene when cannot load a project.
[*] Fix error when loading some older projects.
[*] Fix curve data won't interpolate.
[*] Fix crash when loading project with global variable.
[*] [noparse][Workshop] Fix file ID not saved when upload the project.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Workshop] Fix workshop thumbnail scale incorrectly when using different UI / Theme scaling.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Workshop] Fix workshop thumbnail reset when updating project.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Workshop] Project from workshop now loaded in read only-mode (editable but have to be save in a new place).[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Graph Panel] Fix spacing textbox display in the wrong position.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Graph Panel] Fix some junctions invisible after appending collection.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Graph Panel] Fix quick connect not working with some nodes.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Animation Panel] Fix incorrect graph for hold keyframe.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Animation Panel] Fix keyframe ease out handle disappear when dragging with multiple keyframes selected.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Collection Panel] Fix crash when updating workshop collection.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Canvas] Fix freeform selection bounding box off by one.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Canvas] Fix error when use paste at cursor (ctrl+shift+V).[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Canvas] Fix hitting escape key to clear selection block stop further selection.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Canvas] Hitting escape key while using selection tool will unselect before disabling the tool.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Composite] Fix can't make a selection when using tool in other nodes.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Composite] Fix gizmo not interactable in content-based selection mode.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Composite] Fix error when using largest surface mode.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Frame] Fix frame size reset on load.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Loop File] Fix freeze when no path provided.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][RegEx] Fix crash on empty input.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Repeat] Fix anchor applied incorrectly.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Repeat] Fix global anchor applied to scaled surface incorrectly.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Zoom Blur] Fix error on update.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Shape] Fix corner control disappear in full image mode.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Shape] Corner control now show at the center of the corner not the edge.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Ase Layer] Fix node note receiving file watcher signal.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Group] Fix input junction not reconnect after creating group.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Particle] Fix dimension property doesn't support implicit surface conversion.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][2D Extrude] Fix depth output render highlight in white.[/noparse]

notes.title: 1.19.9 beta
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [noparse][Project] Add default export directory settings.[/noparse]
[/list]

[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add thumbnail tooltip on recent files submenu.
[*] Replace sample projects with samples from the random project collection.
[*] [noparse][File Selector] Add button to navigate to current project directory/[/noparse]
[/list]

New Particle System (pSystem): a custom particle replacement, replacing the current VFX. 
[list]
[*]  
Improved performance 
[*]  
More modular system. 
[*]  
New features: 
[list]
[*] Custom event trigger
[*] Particle mask
[/list]

New nodes (from VFX) 
[list]
[*] pSystem Gravity
[*] pSystem Align Velocity
[*] pSystem Collision
[*] pSystem Sample Color
[*] pSystem Mask

[*] pSystem Trigger Event

Add Krita (.kra), OpenRaster (.ora) supports (output surface, layers).

Add proxy file import for .bmp and .tga file.

[noparse][Shape] Add mask, height outputs.[/noparse]

[noparse][Repeat] Improve performance.[/noparse] 
[*]  
[noparse][Frame] Now resizable from all direction.[/noparse] 
[*]  
[noparse][Splice Spritesheet] Now supports surface array.[/noparse] 
[*]  
[noparse][Canvas] Pasting from selection now done in-place.[/noparse]

[*] [noparse][Loop Array] Fix error when constructing 2D surface array.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Auto tiles] Fix incorrect auto tiling.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Surface is Empty] Now works on Linux.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Level] Normalize now works on Linux.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Mesh From Path] fix Delaunay algo not working.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][3D Particle/Instancer] Fix crash when not outputting any objects.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][3D Particle] Fix spawn amount off by 1.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][3D Particle] Fix loop option not looping seamlessly.[/noparse]
[*] [noparse][Export] Fix extra node appear on creation.[/noparse]

notes.title: 1.19.7 beta

[h2]Interface[/h2]

[h2]What's pre-stable?[/h2]
Pre-stable is a release that will come to a stable branch after some testing in the beta first. Normally stable patches will only contain bug fixes and no new features, but I found some critical bugs after already implementing some features. So I don't want to wait for the next stable to patch them.

notes.title: 1.16.6 beta
notes.content:
[list]
[*]  
Pixel Composer now comes with CLI application `[u]PXC.exe[/u]` which allows for executing PXC project, modifying global variables, and executing functions from the console (`[u]PXC.exe[/u]` use the same arguments as the `[u]PixelComposer.exe[/u]` but with extra arguments). 
[list]
[*] `[u]-v[/u]`, `[u]--verbose[/u]` enable verbose logging
[*] Persistence mode now enables interactive shell. Input will be passed to Pixel Composer as a console command.
[/list] 
[*]  
Add command line arguments. 
[list]
[*] The first argument is a path to the project.
[*] `[u]-h[/u]`, `[u]--headless[/u]` runs the PXC project in headless mode (all nodes will run once, then export nodes will trigger automatically.)
[*] `[u]-p[/u]`, `[u]--persist[/u]` keeps PXC running in the background in headless mode
[*] `[u]-t[/u]`, `[u]--trusted[/u]` trust and runs all execute shell nodes in the project.
[*] `[u]-s[/u]`, `[u]--server port[/u]` create TCP server at the given port (Not tested yet).
[*] `[u]-output <file>[/u]` output debug information to a file (used for debugging)
[*] Global variables can now be set using command-line arguments.
[*] Arguments value can be array using semicolon `[u];[/u]` to separate each value, path string can also use the wildcard `[u]*[/u]`.
[/list] 
[/list]

[h2]Console command[/h2]
[list]
[*] Access through `[u]PXC.exe[/u]` persistence mode or the console panel.
[*] Available commands include: 
[list]
[*] `[u][noparse]flag [debugflag][/noparse][/u]` toggle debug flags
[*] `[u][noparse]set [key] [value][/noparse][/u]` set global variables
[*] `[u]render[/u]` full render and export
[*] `[u]exit[/u]` exit application
[*] general interface functions (will be listed in the future doc)
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing MKFX
notes.content:
MK effects (MKFX) is a new suite of single, built-in nodes made for quick effect. MKFX simplifies setup for commonly used effects with specialized parameter controls.

Pixel Composer nodes were designed to be as modular as possible. When I saw a new effect, I tried to extract it down to the smallest components. However, this leads to some effects requiring too many nodes or systems which leads to both performance and UX problems.

For example, the rain effect which should be very simple to add. Requires complicated setup for particle spawn area, and relies on the caching system which can confuse new users.

To solve this problem, I've introduced MK effects (MKFX) in the Pixel Composer 1.16 update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609281/ed99eef0e60780b0acf291dee442892d277b70ea.png[/img]

Currently, in 1.16.0.2, I've added 5 MKFX nodes, with the sixth one coming in the next patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609281/06d30d48ffaa4add640047749a3d4d650a1d9181.png[/img]

[list]
[*] MK Rains: Deterministic, looping Rain/snow effect generator.
[*] MK Saber: Pixel-accurate sword/trail effect
[*] MK Tile: Tileset generation
[*] MK GridFlip, GridBalls: Just look cool idk
[*] MK Flag: Deterministic, looping flag waving with shadow.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609281/b4d3d28384e3a512676c2e9c6263ac2fbecc5e07.png[/img]

MKFX nodes will allow me to add more fun and complex effects without worrying about modularity and stuff.

It really just a bunch of new nodes I don't know why I need to make a post for this. But hey, the logo is pretty cool, right? Also, you should try MK Tile, I heard someone made an entire software just for this effect.

- MakhamDev

notes.title: 1.16 stable and price increase date
notes.content:
[h2]8 December 2023[/h2]

That'll be the date for the next 1.16 stable release and the date when the price of Pixel Composer will increase to $10. Unless:

- Some catastrophic bug is found in the program that takes a very long time to fix (which is very unlikely)
- Steam takes longer than 1 week to approve the price modification request (which I actually don't know how long it'll take, but it shouldn't be that long... right?).

notes.title: Upcoming Price Increase
notes.content:
Well... it's a long time coming. When the 1.16 stable is out (which I can't say exactly when, but definitely in this year), Pixel Composer will cost $10 instead of the current $5.

The reasons for this decision are:
[list]
[*] I believe Pixel Composer has feature sets beyond its original price. The software is now in a completely different state from the 1.0 version. So this price increase should still make Pixel Composer a good deal.
[*] I just graduated. So if I want to work on Pixel Composer (or as MakhamDev in general) full time, I have to make Pixel Composer a sustainable business (also we just mortgage a house, so it'll be very bad if I can't help them pay for it, while using the house to make money, and I don't know... buy an expensive ass computer). 
[/list]

I had talked about the price situation in the past, but I've been hesitating to do it. Now that Pixel Composer is not just a hobby project anymore. I have to make sure that I have enough financial resources to continue working on it in the future. Also in the past, I've never put Pixel Composer on sale, but with this new price increase, you might see Pixel Composer start getting sales on some special occasions.

I hope you understand this decision, and thank you for your wonderful support throughout the year. 

MakhamDev

	- `Device.timeSecond` Get current second.
	- `Device.timeMinute` Get the current minute.
	- `Device.timeHour` Get the current hour.
	- `Device.timeDay` Get the current day in the month (1 - 31).

[h3]Surface buffer specification[/h3]
- The format for storing surface buffer in Pixel Composer is as below
- The header size is 24 bytes. 

| Offset | Size | Description | 
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 4 | literal text "PXCS" |
| 4 | 2 | surface width |
| 6 | 2 | surface height |
| 8 | 1 | surface format |
| 9 | ... | reserved |

- After the header, byte 24 to the end is a consecutive bit stream for each pixel from left to right, up to down. 
	+ For default format each pixel consists of 8 bit RGBA.

notes.title: Pixel Composer is released
notes.content:
Pixel Composer, a node-based 2D VFX editor for pixel art, is now available to purchase on Steam. The Steam version includes Steam workshop access, allowing you to create and share your creations with others easily.

1.13 Change log:
[h2]General[/h2]
- Gradient data is changed to array.
- Improvement to undo system
	+ Action history dialog
	+ More stability when undo/redo group operation.
	+ More stability when deleting group.
- "Node" junction type now can't be connected to "Any" junction type.
- Add button to execute every export nodes.
- Executable file name, and app data directory renamed to from "Pixels Composer" to "PixelComposer"
	+ The old directory (%APPDATA%/Local/Pixels Composer) will not be removed.
	+ This means all custom collections, assets, palettes, gradients, fonts, presets have to be move manually.
- Autosave system.
- More palette sorting types.
- Disable connection from surface to:
	+ Area
	+ Kernel
	+ Vector range
	+ Puppet control
	+ Padding
	+ Curve
- add option to use legacy exception handler.
- [Steam] Steam workshop support.
	+ Collection
	+ Project
- [Add node] Search now use automaton matcher.

[h2]Interface[/h2]
- Gradient dialog now update while editing.
- Reworked menu bar, borderless fullscreen.
- Add node dialog size now save between session.
- [Notification] Same notification (and warning) now collapse into one with counter.
- [Notification] Improve performance on large number of notification.
- [Inspector] Show metadata of the current context.
- [Inspector] Now show outputs as well (Can't interact, but can copy, access dialog).
- [Preview] Add horizontal, vertical tiling mode.
- [Scroll menu] Value preview when mouse hover.

[h2]Nodes[/h2]
- New SDF (signed distance field) node.
- New find pixel node.
- New path operator nodes.
	+ Path remap
	+ Path transform
	+ Path shift
	+ Path trim
	+ Path wave
- New Loop Array node which allow a "for each" operation to each member in an array and output a new array.
- New sort palette node.
- New cache array node.
- New trail node with sub-frame blending.
- New gradient shift node.

- Number of nodes changed to array processor.
	- 3D transform
	- HSV color
	- RGB color
	- Gradient
	- Palette
- [Array get] Now accept array in "index" property.
- [Path] Now accept array in "path progress" property.
- [Palette extract] Improve performance, add option to deal with animated surface.
- [Render Sprite Sheet] Setting sprite set to "image array" will make the node runs automatically.
- [Render sprite sheet] Manually execute the node will now execute all Render sprite sheet nodes.
- [Composite] Improve preview gizmo.
- [Blend] Add hue, saturation, luminosity blend modes.
- [Blend] Add no tile mode with alignment options.
- [Repeat] Option to spread surface array into repeated output array.
- [Export] Now work in loop.
- [Splice sprite sheet] Now work in loop.
- [Colorize] Now works with HSV gradient.
- [Palette extract] Now skip transparent pixel.
- [Composite] Multiply alpha by default.
- [Line] Add round cap.
- [Grid] Shifting now scale with tile size.
- [Scatter point] Add option to fix point position and use area to enable/disable points.
- [Scatter point] Now output value of each point.
- [Scatter] Random value now use positional based seed for stability.
- [Scatter] Can use value from scatter data to control scale.
- [Particle] Improve performance, caching.
- [3D nodes] Option to not fixing view to dimension. (Should allow changing dimension without affecting image scale.)
- Option to deactivate node from render tree.
- More accurate render time calculation in loop node.

[h2]Bug[/h2]
- Fix memory leak caused by blurring in Gaussian blur, Glow, Shadow, and Bloom nodes.
- Fix memory leak caused by average node.
- Fix line in text area not breaking properly.
- Fix duplicating group not copying the content, connections.
- Fix crash when change gravity in preference.
- Fix crash when open, create new project while opening dialog.
- Fix cloning gradient value gives unexpected color.
- Fix decimal precision can't go lower than 0.01.
- Fix infinite looping when executing array loop.
- Fix file not found error not remove when destroyed.
- Mix property now works without mask.
- [Image array] Fix images not loaded properly when create node from add node dialog.
- [Image array] Fix images path dialog not accept multiple images.
- [Array] Last value is now hidden.
- [Loop] Add warning notification when try to connect output directly to input node.
- [Evaluate curve] Fix crash on create.
- [Color data] Fix crash on create.
- [Wiggler] Fix crash when supply array value.
- [Frame] Fix frame selection bug.
- [3D Obj] Fix parts of the model not loaded.
- [3D Obj] Fix flip UV create duplicate texture and shift UV in the x-axis.
- [Shadow caster] Fix crash when selecting the node.
- [Composite] Fix error when disconnecting surface.
- [Blend] Fix crash when blend mode is set outside available blend types.
- [Inspector] Fix crash when right-clicking on a property.
- [Particle] Fix particle alpha not updating.
- [Grid noise] Shift value now act like grid node.
- [Repeat] Fix error when set column to 0.
- [Scatter] Fix seed not apply on custom distribution map.
- [Radial blur] Fix effect not applying.
- [Ase in] Fix importing error.
